key_insight: Entire sig-jump-diffusions make expected signatures computable through linear ODEs, enabling score-based generative modeling for time series and finite-dimensional data.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a deterministic route to learning generalized scores for jump-diffusion generators using linear ODE solvers and optimization.
method: Define jump-diffusions whose characteristics depend linearly on potentially infinitely many signature components.
Compute expected signatures via linear ODEs; polynomial jump-diffusions admit finite-dimensional systems.
Learn generalized scores through deterministic optimization or inverse signature matching.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical computability and embedding results, but no datasets, empirical benchmarks, or quantitative generation metrics.
watch_item: Outside the polynomial setting, implementing the extended-tensor-algebra ODEs may require truncation, with accuracy and computational cost needing assessment.
paper_title: Entire sig-jump-diffusions, their expected signature and applications to score-based generative modeling
